_description: Single-year $50k Roth conversion at age 65 with no tax. Verifies Trad drops by 50k and Roth rises by 50k, with ordinaryTax=0 (Florida + single standard deduction covers $50k below the taxable threshold minus brackets).
_rationale: Age 65, Traditional $200k + Roth $0. One-time $50k conversion in year 0. No state tax (Florida). Filing single, age 65 → standard deduction ≈ $15,000 + senior extra ≈ $1,950 ≈ $16,950. $50k conversion produces $33,050 taxable, 10% bracket ≈ $1,160 + 12% bracket on balance. So some tax applies. To fully zero tax, use MFJ with both 65+ (deduction ~$30k). Using MFJ 65+/65+: std deduction ≈ $31,000 + senior extra for both. Conversion well within deduction → ordinaryTax ≈ 0.
name: Roth Conversion — Simple No Tax
